messages:
sanjay: Heads up — after the driver/CUDA rollout in us-west-2 H100 pools (driver 535.86, CUDA 12.2) some nodes are reporting PTX/kernel failures. Seeing a spike in failed model starts and OOM-like kernel launch errors. 

emma: Can you paste the exact error? Is this only H100 or also A100 pools?

sanjay: Only H100 so far. Here's the common log snippet from the runtime pods: 

```
2026-03-16T09:12:11Z ERROR runtime: ptxas failed: /usr/local/cuda/bin/ptxas: error: ptx input, unsupported target 'sm_90'
2026-03-16T09:12:11Z ERROR runtime: kernel launch failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_PTX
ModelLoadError: failed to compile device code for sm_90
```

zara: We also saw NCCL reductions failing intermittently after the upgrade (NCCL 2.15.5). Some jobs degraded throughput due to fallback to slower kernels.

ryan: infra-bot alerted us at 09:14 with 30% of H100 machines in us-west-2 showing driver mismatch vs expected.

infra-bot: [ALERT] H100-driver-rolling: 31 nodes (of 210) reporting missing sm_90 compilation support. Trigger: driver_version != min_required for sm_90.

emma: Quick hypothesis: kernel toolchain (ptxas / ptx version) in the image is older than what driver 535 expects, so PTX with sm_90 is unrecognized. Could also be a missing libcuda.so symlink or runtime AND driver minor mismatch.

sanjay: Confirmed: images used for the canary still have CUDA toolkit 12.1 ptxas binary built without sm_90 support. The node drivers were upgraded to 535.86 which expects PTX v8 with SM90 support in the ptxas. We're generating sm_90 codepaths, ptxas fails -> runtime falls back or errors.

zara: Affected workloads: dedicated customer clusters on H100 (us-west-2), internal stress tests hitting SM90-optimized kernels, and a fraction of hosted API inference that hits large-seq paths. Not seeing A100 regressions.

ryan: Current impact: ~7% failed requests for certain models, degradation in latency tail for others. Cost: extra retries + fallback -> ~12% CPU/GPU time increase in affected zone.

emma: Immediate mitigation options: 
- rollback driver to previous (534.x) on affected nodes, OR
- rebuild runtime container/toolchain with matching ptxas that supports sm_90 (CUDA toolkit 12.2+), OR
- force compile-time target to sm_80 to avoid sm_90 codegen (if acceptable perf-wise)

sanjay: We rolled a targeted rollback on the most critical Dedicated pools (2 AZs) at 09:30 — that stopped the ptxas errors for those nodes. Canary remains failing.

zara: For private customers running air-gapped images, we need to notify them: driver-toolchain mismatch could break model start.

ryan: Oncall suggestion: pause further driver rollouts in all regions until we validate toolkit mismatch and have a deterministic canary that tests SM90 codegen.

infra-bot: [ACTION] rollback_started by sanjay at 1732467820. Rolling back 22 nodes in us-west-2a.

emma: Will start rebuilding the runtime image with CUDA 12.2 and ptxas that supports sm_90. ETA for image build + canary deploy: ~2 hours.

sanjay: Short-term: pin driver upgrade gate for H100 pools until build is validated. Also add a preflight: compile small SM90 kernel on node during canary to validate ptxas/driver combo before full rollout.

zara: Also check libcuda/ldconfig differences — some nodes had leftover vendor driver remnants after the automated upgrade which caused inconsistent behavior.

ryan: Noted action items: 
- (sanjay) Halt rollout in other regions (done)
- (emma) Produce a test image with CUDA 12.2 ptxas and run SM90 compile test (ETA 2h)
- (zara) Contact Dedicated customer success for affected clusters + create incident inbox thread
- (ops-ci) Add preflight compile test to driver-rollout pipeline

ops-ci: Pipeline change queued: add `sm_90_compile_test.sh` to preflight. Test will compile a small kernel and run a sanity launch.

sanjay: We'll follow-up with a short postmortem once root cause is confirmed. For now, if you own any H100 pools, please check node driver version and docker images for CUDA toolkit mismatch. Report in this thread. :exclamation:

zara: Quick check: 3 private clusters in eu-west-1 show the same failure pattern — opening support tickets for those customers now.

emma: Repro steps already added to the runtime repo issue: run `ptxas --version` inside image, compile a sm_90 module, and validate kernel loads. Link: https://git.internal/runtime/issues/489

ryan: If anyone sees a sudden jump in 5xxs for inference in us-west-2, please tag me. I'll keep an eye on cluster health dashboards.

sanjay: Thanks all — I'll update when rollback completes and when we have the new image canary results. :thumbsup:
